# @surfaces-ui/state

Reusable state services for Surfaces UI: stores, persistence, URL sync, undo, shared view state and query runs.

State services with no React or DOM dependency: stores, derived values, undo, persistence to any `StateStorage`, URL sync, the shared view state behind cross-filtering, and query runs. React hooks are in `@surfaces-ui/state/react`.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/state react
```

`react` is a peer dependency: your app provides it.

## Use

```tsx
import { browserStorage, createViewState, parseViewState, persist } from "@surfaces-ui/state";
import { useStore } from "@surfaces-ui/state/react";

const view = createViewState();
persist(view, { key: "dashboard", storage: browserStorage(), parse: parseViewState });

// In a chart: view.toggle("region", "EU") on a click, and filters={view.filters("region")}
// so the chart never filters away the bars a person clicks.
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.

Every Surfaces UI package is released at the same version; install them all at that one version, since mixing releases is not supported.
